attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his July 2024 newsletter post, given as his own view.

semantics.note: Firm present-tense description: the companies lose money and have no clear path to profit. The normalised version drops the Red Queen metaphor but keeps both parts. 'No clear path' is an evaluative judgment rather than a measurable fact.

contract.note: Plain reading. The contract uses OpenAI and Anthropic in calendar 2024; the surrounding text names both companies, so the choice is ordinary. Judging 'no clear path' by whether the companies were profitable or near break-even is a reasonable stand-in and does not stretch his words either way.

evidence.note: CNBC, Sept 2024: OpenAI expected about $5B of losses on $3.7B revenue in 2024. This is a company projection from documents shown to investors, not audited, but it meets the source requirements.

Secondary summary of Reuters' report on Anthropic's prospectus: 2024 operating loss of about $2.98B. Published Sept 2026, before the evaluation date. An operating loss is allowed by the measurement requirements.
Fortune: OpenAI projects revenue of $11.6B in 2025 and $100B by 2029. These are forecasts, not profits, so they bear on 'no clear path' without contradicting the loss core.

reviews.rationale: Both named leading generative AI companies lost large sums against their 2024 revenue: OpenAI about $5B on $3.7B, Anthropic about $3B in operating losses. Neither was profitable or near break-even, which meets the support condition. OpenAI's growth projections are not demonstrated profits. The 'no clear path' part stays a judgment, weighed here only through 2024 profitability as the contract says.
